data.description: A shaitan binder's eidolon gains the ability to grant its summoner's wishes. Once per day, the eidolon can cast limited wish as a spelllike ability. The eidolon's caster level is %1. The wish must be spoken aloud by the shaitan binder, beginning with the words "I wish," and cannot duplicate a wish the eidolon has granted within the past 24 hours. If the eidolon uses this ability to duplicate a spell with a costly material component, the shaitan binder must provide that component.|MasterLevel
